subject: Computer Vision Peers in Defense Tech
text:

We haven't met yet, but I've been speaking with a lot of your peers in your
space - [SENDER] Maggy (Firestorm), Max Romero (Overland AI), Steven Simoni
(ACS), and teams at Anduril and Shield AI.

We're helping defence CV teams scale ML pipelines where first-gen or
open-source tools like Voxel51 and CVAT start to struggle, especially with
video data (we support video natively, no breaking video into frames).

Encord is a multimodal DataOps platform that unifies curation, annotation
and model evaluation. I'd love to show how others in your ecosystem are
using us and see whether there's a fit for [COMPANY].

We're free Wednesday or Thursday morning - what works for you for a quick
virtual coffee?
